Articles

Concepts

The z scale
Layers

Worked examples of points, paths, gridded surfaces, columns, distributions, intervals and reference geometry.

Surfaces, solids and fields

Worked examples of indexed meshes, function and fitted surfaces, density surfaces, level surfaces, hulls, solid glyphs and sweeps along curves.

Workflows

Camera and framing

Set camera angles, projection, framing and stereo output for static scenes.

Output backends

Choose vector, raster, hybrid or traced rendering and save figures at the intended resolution.

Lighting and surface styles
Ray marching and volumes

Trace signed distance surfaces, integrate scalar volumes and accumulate seeded path-traced images.

Interactive viewing

Explore WebGL 2 scenes with tooltips, picking, selection, linked cameras and crosstalk filters.

Exporting plots and scenes

Write model files, animated glTF, semantic SVG, TikZ and Asymptote, or pass scenes to rgl and rayrender.

Camera animation and interaction

Render camera moves, tween points and surfaces between data states, and explore linked interactive panels.

Combining 2D and 3D graphics

Place ggplot2 panels on walls, stack slices in depth, draw terraced contours and arrange 2D and 3D plots.

Documents

Use knitr and Quarto to choose HTML viewers or static figures, supply alt text and compose panels.

Maps and spatial data

Draw raster terrain, simple features and XYZ geometry, prism maps, profiles, flow arcs and space-time paths.

Vector fields

Draw vector arrows, magnitude-scaled cones, integrated streamlines and solid streamtubes from a gridded field.

Examples

Gallery

Worked plots of solid curves, distributions, covariance ellipsoids, streamtubes, cutaways and contour terraces alongside familiar charts.

Linear and nonlinear PDEs

Exact solutions of four linear and four nonlinear partial differential equations drawn as surfaces that change over time with animate_3d().

Implicit surfaces

Draw level sets from functions, reconstruct surfaces from point clouds and triangulate scattered height measurements.

Inside the Thurston geometries

Render an observer view in each of the eight Thurston geometries using intrinsic balls and geodesics.
